findings.evidence: grep for `photonVirtualityMin_pos` in `EpsilonEridani/` returns only its own declaration and the module docstring; lines 279-281 call `emissionVirtuality_zero_pos_iff ... .2 ⟨hm.ne', _⟩` directly.
findings.fix: State it at the energy level, e.g. `(hm : 0 < s.mass) (hE : s.mass ≤ s.energy) (hx : 0 < x) (hE' : s.mass ≤ (1 - x) * s.energy) : 0 < s.photonVirtualityMin x`, and derive the γ-form (`1 ≤ (1 - x) * s.gamma`) as a corollary if wanted; then `not_isReal_of_mem_photonRegion` applies it at `x = k.energyFraction s` rather than redoing the argument. Same restatement applies to `sq_mass_mul_sq_div_lt_photonVirtualityMin` (line 170), which shares `energy_bounds`.
findings.issue: `photonVirtualityMin_pos` assumes `0 < x`, `x < 1`, `1 ≤ (1 - x) * s.gamma` (via `energy_bounds`), a γ-packaged form that no consumer can supply: `photonRegion` membership gives `0 < k.energy` and `k.energy < s.energy - s.mass`. As a result the lemma has no use in the repo and `not_isReal_of_mem_photonRegion` (lines 278-281) reproves the same fact from `emissionVirtuality_zero_pos_iff` by hand.

findings.evidence: Lines 279-283: `hpos : 0 < emissionVirtuality ...` together with `hmin : ... ≤ k.virtuality`, then `rw [PhotonKin.isReal_iff]; linarith` — the stronger inequality is in context.
findings.fix: State `0 < k.virtuality` as the theorem (e.g. `virtuality_pos_of_mem_photonRegion`) and obtain `¬ k.IsReal` as a one-line corollary via `PhotonKin.isReal_iff` and `.ne'`.
findings.issue: `not_isReal_of_mem_photonRegion` concludes only `¬ k.IsReal` although its proof establishes `0 < emissionVirtuality s.mass s.energy (s.energy - k.energy) 0 ≤ k.virtuality`. The strict positivity is exactly the roadmap's point ("the virtuality integral has a strictly positive lower limit", per the module docstring at line 28), and it is thrown away at the last `linarith`.

findings.evidence: Proof body rewrites `hp` with `minkowskiProduct_self_eq_sq_sub` to `p.timeComponent ^ 2 - ‖p.spatialPart‖ ^ 2 = m ^ 2` and closes by `linarith`; substituting `⟪p, p⟫ₘ` for `m ^ 2` makes the statement an unconditional consequence of that Physlib lemma.
findings.fix: State `‖p.spatialPart‖ = √(p.timeComponent ^ 2 - ⟪p, p⟫ₘ)` with no hypothesis (same one-line proof from `minkowskiProduct_self_eq_sq_sub`); at the two use sites in `neg_minkowskiProduct_sub_self_eq_emissionVirtuality` rewrite with `hp`/`hp'` afterwards.
findings.issue: `norm_spatialPart_eq_sqrt` carries an avoidable mass-shell hypothesis `⟪p, p⟫ₘ = m ^ 2` and an auxiliary variable `m`; the identity holds for every `p` with the Minkowski square in place of `m²`.

summary: The core angle/virtuality development sits at the right level, but the source-level positivity lemma is stated with γ-form hypotheses that do not match the `photonRegion` membership conditions, so `not_isReal_of_mem_photonRegion` reproves it instead of applying it; that same theorem also discards the strict positivity it establishes, and `norm_spatialPart_eq_sqrt` carries a removable mass-shell hypothesis.
